subject.title: fix(mcp): stop ignored disabled servers from starting

question: Should existing configurations containing the ineffective `mcp.servers.*.disabled` key fail validation until `openclaw doctor --fix` migrates them?
rationale: The implementation is technically sound, but accepting a guided fail-closed upgrade rather than continued startup compatibility is a maintainer policy choice.

options.title: Accept guided migration
options.body: Land the validation and doctor repair while keeping runtime on the single canonical `enabled` field.

options.title: Require softer compatibility
options.body: Pause and redesign upgrade handling if legacy files must continue normal startup without an explicit doctor repair.

recommendation.title: Accept guided migration
recommendation.body: Land the validation and doctor repair while keeping runtime on the single canonical `enabled` field.
